description: Register a QuickBooksResource wrapping the QuickBooks Online Accounting API. OAuth2 refresh-token flow; every request is scoped to realm_id (the QuickBooks company/tenant id). Exposes request() + query() (QBO's SQL-like query language).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

realm_id.label: Realm ID
realm_id.description: QuickBooks company/tenant id (realmId), returned during OAuth authorization.

client_id_env_var.label: Client ID Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var with OAuth2 Client ID

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var with OAuth2 Client Secret

refresh_token_env_var.label: Refresh Token Env Var
refresh_token_env_var.description: Env var with OAuth2 Refresh Token

minor_version.label: Minor Version
minor_version.description: QuickBooks API minor version (appended to every request).

name: QuickBooks Resource
